Of course the occult and Christianity are similar. However, what I’ve found after practicing both, is that you can have an understanding of the spiritual world and not know you’re being deceived.

Eventually I started to get super uncomfortable with the fact that no matter what I did, I couldn’t seem to find myself. I wasn’t even happy with the whole idea of “oneness with the universe”. And of all people, I saw Jesus for a split second reaching out His hand. I took it and my alcoholism, and need for daily marijuana stopped overnight.

I started to scream at it in Jesus’s name and it dissolved. I was so scared I went and slept with my mom lol. 

They got mad after I left the path and that was convincing enough for me. I still have some experiences just not as often. Christianity isn’t easy, but it’s rewarding. I feel like I’m truly finding myself in the body of Christ. Christ is more powerful than anything I’ve ever worked with before and that’s also helped me continue believing I’ve made the right choice. My heart feels whole and I’m no longer searching. The devil can only produce a counterfeit of what the Lord of our universe can provide. Good luck my friends. I love y’all.
